schema.name: billToCustomerID
schema.description: Customer ID to which the bill is sent

schema.name: subscriptionID
schema.description: The ID of the subscription if this appointment belongs to a subscription. Standalone services or reservices will be -1.

schema.name: appointmentDate
schema.description: The date this appointment is scheduled for.

schema.name: duration
schema.description: The number of minutes this appointment is scheduled for.

schema.name: type
schema.description: The service type ID of this appointment.

schema.name: status
schema.description: The status code of this appointment.

schema.name: isInitial
schema.description: Whether or not this is the initial appointment for the associated subscription. 1: yes, 0: no.

schema.name: servicedBy
schema.description: The employee ID of the technician who serviced this appointment.

schema.name: timeIn
schema.description: The time the technician checked into the appointment.

schema.name: timeOut
schema.description: The time the technician checked out of the appointment.

schema.name: ticketID
schema.description: The ticket/invoice ID associated with the appointment.

schema.name: recordCreatedAt
schema.description: A created timestamp logs when a record is added.

schema.name: dateUpdated
schema.description: The date the appointment was updated

schema.name: fname
schema.description: The first name of the customer

schema.name: lname
schema.description: The last name of the customer.

schema.description: The date the appointment was updated

schema.name: companyName
schema.description: The company name of the customer

schema.name: masterNumber
schema.description: CustomerID for the master account in the connected property

schema.name: phone1
schema.description: The primary phone number of the customer

schema.name: phone2
schema.description: The secondary phone number of the customer

schema.name: customerNumber
schema.description: Customer Number that comes from the integration

schema.name: individualAccountID
schema.description: Column mapped with Billing Account which this subscription belongs to

schema.name: dateAdded
schema.description: Date this subscription was added / created. Sold date.

schema.name: active
schema.description: 0: frozen, 1: active and being placed in the job pool.

schema.name: recurringCharge
schema.description: A shortcut for the subtotal of the recurring ticket

schema.name: annualRecurringValue
schema.description: Calculated as the recurringCharge * the number of services/year.

schema.name: serviceID
schema.description: The service type ID for the regular recurring services

schema.name: dateCancelled
schema.description: The date the subscription was cancelled if any.

schema.name: recurringTicket
schema.description: The recurring ticket template associated with this subscription

schema.name: annualRecurringServices
schema.description: Services per year without counting initial
